query.text: exec ISWIFTStoreTableLoading '@@table', '@@fieldKey', '@@fields', @@fieldOrder, '', '', 'left join reguserinfo b on a.parent_user = b.user_id left join dmbgn c on a.type_member = c.ma_bgn and ma_ct=''RSU'' ', 'b.username as parent_username, c.ten_bgn ten_type', '@@key', '', @@filterKey, '', @pageIndex, 50, @@admin, @@userId

request.text:
declare @r as nvarchar(1000) select @r = ''
if @@admin = 0 select @r = N'AdminAccess' if exists(select 1 from reguserinfo where admin = 1 and user_id = @user_id) select @r = N'NotAuthorized' select @r as result
